title: Monitor Tool — Background Script Streaming
description: New built-in tool that spawns a background process and streams each stdout line into the active session without blocking it. Claude can point it at any long-running script (e.g., `kubectl logs -f | grep ..`) and receive output as it arrives, then act on events. Eliminates the pattern of polling Bash commands in a loop or opening a second session for log tailing. Use cases: CI log monitoring, test runner output, build watchers, log stream analysis.

evaluation.reasoning: Genuinely novel built-in tool — no equivalent exists in the stack. Eliminates the Bash polling loop anti-pattern for long-running processes (CI logs, test runners, build watchers). Official v2.1.98, zero config, zero maintenance. Token efficiency boost from replacing polling loops. Highest-priority item in this batch.
